require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'pathname'
require 'securerandom'

module CIPipeline
  ROLES = { 'admin' => 3, 'developer' => 2, 'viewer' => 1 }.freeze
  ARTIFACTS_ROOT = '/var/ci/artifacts'
  BUILD_LOGS_ROOT = '/var/ci/logs'

  class AccessControl
    def initialize(user_role, project_id)
      @role_level = ROLES.fetch(user_role, 0)
      @project_id = project_id
    end

    def can_read_artifacts?
      @role_level >= 2
    end

    def can_read_logs?
      @role_level >= 1
    end

    def can_list_directory?
      @role_level >= 2
    end

    def can_admin?
      @role_level >= 3
    end
  end

  class PathResolver
    def initialize(base_root)
      @base_root = File.realpath(base_root)
    end

    def resolve(relative_path)
      cleaned = sanitize_path(relative_path)
      candidate = File.join(@base_root, cleaned)
      resolved = File.expand_path(candidate)
      unless resolved.start_with?(@base_root)
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected"
      end
      resolved
    end

    private

    def sanitize_path(path)
      # Remove null bytes and normalize separators
      path.gsub("\0", '').gsub('\\', '/')
    end
  end

  class DirectoryLister
    def initialize(path_resolver, access_control)
      @resolver = path_resolver
      @acl = access_control
    end

    def list(relative_path, options = {})
      unless @acl.can_list_directory?
        return { error: 'Forbidden', status: 403 }
      end

      resolved_path = @resolver.resolve(relative_path)

      unless File.directory?(resolved_path)
        return { error: 'Not a directory', status: 404 }
      end

      entries = Dir.entries(resolved_path).reject { |e| e.start_with?('.') }

      if options[:recursive]
        entries = list_recursive(resolved_path, resolved_path)
      end

      { entries: entries, path: relative_path, status: 200 }
    end

    private

    def list_recursive(current_path, base_path)
      results = []
      Dir.foreach(current_path) do |entry|
        next if entry == '.' || entry == '..'
        full_path = File.join(current_path, entry)
        relative = full_path.sub(base_path + '/', '')
        if File.directory?(full_path)
          results << { name: relative, type: 'directory' }
          results.concat(list_recursive(full_path, base_path))
        else
          results << { name: relative, type: 'file', size: File.size(full_path) }
        end
      end
      results
    end
  end

  class BuildArtifactServer < Sinatra::Base
    before do
      content_type :json
      authenticate!
    end

    helpers do
      def authenticate!
        token = request.env['HTTP_X_CI_TOKEN']
        halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json unless token
        @session = validate_token(token)
        halt 401, { error: 'Invalid token' }.to_json unless @session
      end

      def validate_token(token)
        # Token format: base64(role:project_id:timestamp:hmac)
        decoded = Base64.decode64(token) rescue nil
        return nil unless decoded
        parts = decoded.split(':')
        return nil unless parts.length == 4
        { role: parts[0], project_id: parts[1] }
      end

      def build_acl
        AccessControl.new(@session[:role], @session[:project_id])
      end

      def select_root(scope)
        case scope
        when 'artifacts' then ARTIFACTS_ROOT
        when 'logs' then BUILD_LOGS_ROOT
        else nil
        end
      end
    end

    get '/api/v1/projects/:project_id/browse' do
      project_id = params[:project_id]
      scope = params[:scope] || 'artifacts'
      path = params[:path] || ''
      recursive = params[:recursive] == 'true'

      root = select_root(scope)
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid scope' }.to_json unless root

      acl = build_acl
      project_root = File.join(root, project_id)

      unless File.directory?(project_root)
        halt 404, { error: 'Project not found' }.to_json
      end

      resolver = PathResolver.new(project_root)
      lister = DirectoryLister.new(resolver, acl)

      result = lister.list(path, recursive: recursive)
      status result[:status]
      result.to_json
    end

    get '/api/v1/projects/:project_id/tree' do
      project_id = params[:project_id]
      scope = params[:scope] || 'artifacts'
      subpath = params[:subpath] || ''

      root = select_root(scope)
      halt 400, { error: 'Invalid scope' }.to_json unless root

      acl = build_acl

      # Tree endpoint uses a simplified check - viewers can see structure
      unless acl.can_read_logs?
        halt 403, { error: 'Forbidden' }.to_json
      end

      # Construct the browseable path for the tree view
      tree_base = File.join(root, project_id)
      target = File.join(tree_base, subpath)
      normalized = File.expand_path(target)

      # Verify the path is within the expected root
      unless normalized.start_with?(root)
        halt 403, { error: 'Access denied' }.to_json
      end

      unless File.directory?(normalized)
        halt 404, { error: 'Path not found' }.to_json
      end

      entries = Dir.glob(File.join(normalized, '*')).map do |f|
        { name: File.basename(f), type: File.directory?(f) ? 'dir' : 'file' }
      end

      { tree: entries, base: subpath }.to_json
    end
  end
end
